description: A PHP script providing REST API endpoints for device feature management, including token generation, validation, and request handling for EasyConnect feature, along with some cryptographic and request validation functions.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an encryption key stored in a specific file, creating the file if necessary.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Generates an encrypted token with a set expiration time based on the key.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates a given encrypted token by decrypting it and checking if it is still valid based on current time.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests related to device configuration, specifically handling DPP provisioning.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Authenticates an API caller using tokens or challenge-response validation.
